name: Shiroi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shiroi city emblem in white: a disc with a pointed upper fly enclosing a green ring with a white four-pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Shiroi, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1981.

features.role: Shiroi city emblem — a disc with a pointed upper fly enclosing a green ring with a white four-pointed device
